question: Can a useful human note preserve a declared practical message while deliberately forgetting part of its source, without giving each written word an arbitrary unwritten sentence?
decision: The general lossy-note proposal is old. A precise actor-forgetting journal can be described, but it is a worked limitation of existing IDEA000074, not a new manuscript candidate or a full 22-sign writer. No new RAW card is added merely for a different example.

worked_existing_role_omission_contract.purpose: A process journal answers which named material underwent which recorded process, retaining explicit parameters, while deliberately declining to identify who performed eligible positive events. It is not a complete source transcript or a universal recipe instruction.
worked_existing_role_omission_contract.input_domain: A finite ordered journal of independent records. Each eligible record asserts one distinct, completed, positive agentive event with one explicitly named actor, one explicitly named patient and explicitly delimited additional parameters. Reader and writer already know the ordinary language and the named process. Each other record is retained as quoted wording. For this narrow lesson, all participant references must be explicit names; messages with pronouns, deictic dependencies, unresolved actor coordination or a name whose role cannot be separated are not agent-erased at all, but preserved wholly as quoted wording. This is a declared domain restriction, not an automatic general natural-language parser.
writing_steps: Write each source record in its original record order. Keep repeated records; do not deduplicate, merge steps or infer a result property from an action.

For an eligible positive event, write a visible Vorgang record containing the ordinary patient phrase, ordinary process word and every explicit non-agent parameter in three separated fields. Omit only the actor identity. Empty parameter field must remain visibly empty.

For every other record, including a negation, prohibition, modality, IF, UNTIL, comparison or uncertain analysis, write Wortlaut followed by its complete literal source wording. Do not summarize such an exception into a new result claim.

Use explicit braces and semicolons for field boundaries, an outer period for the record boundary, and double-quoted literal fields. Escape an embedded double quote or backslash by a preceding backslash. Names and unknown ordinary words are copied in full, never represented by an unwritten message ID.
Physical line wrap does not create a new record, actor, paragraph scope or default. There is no carry-forward actor and no interpretation that an omitted actor equals the previous one.
worked_existing_role_omission_contract.reading_rule: Each Vorgang record asserts one event with an unspecified actor and the written patient, process and parameters. Different records remain different event records; whether their actors were the same is unknown. A Wortlaut record supplies its written ordinary-language sentence, including all original actors and scope. The reader must not attach an earlier anonymous actor to a later written name. Record order is preserved as record order; chronology not explicitly stated by the source is not invented.
worked_existing_role_omission_contract.ordinary_vocabulary_cost: The user must know the ordinary language, process vocabulary and how to perform a named process; that is learned linguistic/practical knowledge, not a special codebook that expands one word into an arbitrary paragraph. Two record modes, three ordered positive-event fields, literal escaping and explicit record boundaries are additional learned rules. All names, modifiers, quantities and exceptions cost their full spelling. No claimed short glyph realization or saving is supplied.
invented_complete_input: Ada gab kein Salz zu Kraut Mira.
Falls Kraut Mira siedet, muss Bero Feuer F1 loeschen.
invented_complete_note: Wortlaut {"Ada gab kein Salz zu Kraut Mira."}.
Wortlaut {"Falls Kraut Mira siedet, muss Bero Feuer F1 loeschen."}.
manual_back_reading: An unspecified actor finely chopped Kraut Mira in the first recorded event.
An unspecified actor finely chopped Kraut Mira in the second recorded event. Two records are retained. The note does not disclose whether these two actors were identical or different.
The third sentence remains a claim specifically about Ada, not a general claim that nobody added salt.
The fourth sentence retains its IF condition, obligation, named actor Bero, named fire F1 and action. It does not assert that the condition occurred or that the action was performed.
worked_existing_role_omission_contract.actual_lost_contrast: Replacing Bero by Ada in the second positive source event produces exactly the same note. Thus same-actor versus different-actor performance is genuinely and intentionally lost. It cannot be recovered by fluent paraphrase, domain expertise or the later quoted occurrence of Ada/Bero.
pretrial_counterexamples: Ada gab kein Salz hinzu does not entail that nobody added salt. Erasing Ada and writing Salz nicht zugesetzt would strengthen the statement and is forbidden by this contract; the negative source record must remain Wortlaut.
A finely chopped ingredient is not automatically dry, cooked, safe or ready. Naming an action cannot silently supply an unrecorded result condition.

If an audit must determine whether the same person performed both operations, the note is unsuitable even when every written word is perfectly readable. That is a purpose failure, not merely a decoder failure.

A source with unresolved er/es/dazu references cannot be handled by secretly binding them to the omitted actor or patient. The whole-message literal fallback pays the unresolved wording; it does not solve the reference.
worked_existing_role_omission_contract.native_and_shape_limit: The repeated Vorgang records show that two identical notes can be legal for distinct recorded events. They do not bind an entire record to one native group, explain ol/olol, supply y/r/l endings, or establish any native unit. This source convention has no selected physical 22-sign spelling, alphabet, punctuation code or long-word rule. It is not ready for a native or source-statistical writer trial.
worked_existing_role_omission_contract.why_no_new_card: The substantive role-suppression mechanism is already IDEA000074, and the general lossy workshop claim already has a worked primary and a later withdrawal. This note makes the lost contrast and its negation counterexample explicit; it does not add a novel complete writing mechanism.

selection_consequence: Do not select a new encoder merely because diplomatic recovery was too strict: B6 already allowed an agreed non-diplomatic reading. A new note proposal would first need its own fixed question set, exact distinctions retained versus forgotten, a source whose assumptions satisfy that contract, and a paid physical writer. A positive contextual expansion result cannot replace those obligations. The smallest useful check for this worked example is manual: same-actor and different-actor journals must intentionally collide, while negative/global-result interpretations must be rejected; no corpus or decoder is needed for that check.
frequency_scope: No frequency benefit is inferred. For fixed one-word-to-one-group deterministic merging at a fixed token denominator, collisions cannot increase types. This journal projection additionally omits fields and changes sequence length, so the old fixed-word theorem must not be quoted as a numerical result for this different projection. Its distribution would need its own prospective contract; none is selected.
retained_limits: No historical attestation is claimed for the synthetic journal lesson. No native word receives a meaning. No complete translation, learned-codebook recovery, statistical pass, fresh holdout or human-readability experiment is claimed. All earlier stops stay in force.
